NONE: › old use to help or be useful to someone or something
› Indian English to make use of something

example: We tried to persuade her not to resign, but to no avail (= did not succeed).
我們力勸她不要辭職，可是沒有用。
My attempts to improve the situation were of little/no avail.
我竭力扭轉局面，但是收效甚微／徒勞無功。
Our efforts availed us nothing (= did not help).
我們的努力全是白費。
Over a thousand learners have already availed the opportunity to study at our college.
已經有超過一千名學生抓住機會在我校學習。
To avail this offer, please click here.
如要接受該優惠，請按這裡。
Employees should avail themselves of the opportunity to buy cheap shares in the company.
僱員應利用這次機會低價認購公司股份。

NONE: B2 the fact that something can be bought, used, or reached, or how much it can be
B2 the fact of someone being free to speak on the phone, work, etc.

example: The ready availability of guns has contributed to the escalating violence.
人們太容易得到槍械，這也成了暴力事件激增的一個誘因。
Abortion rates are high because the availability of contraceptives is limited.
由於避孕藥物的獲得途徑有限，墮胎率居高不下。
I shall check the availability of my staff for that date.
我會去看看那天員工能不能工作。

NONE: A2 able to be bought or used
› If someone is available, they are not busy and therefore able to do something.

example: Is this dress available in a larger size?
這件衣服有大一號的嗎？
Our autumn catalogue is now available from our usual stockists.
秋季商品目錄現已推出，請到我們公司零售處索取。
There's no money available for an office party this year.
今年沒有錢舉辦辦公室派對了。
It is vital that food is made available to the famine areas.
一定要把食品送到遭受饑荒的地區，這是至關重要的。
Do you have any double rooms available this weekend?
你們飯店本週末有沒有雙人房？
Every available officer will be assigned to the investigation.
每一名可以調用的員警都將會被派去進行調查。

NONE: › a large amount of ice, snow, and rock falling quickly down the side of a mountain
› too many things that arrive or happen at the same time
大量；突然到來的一大批

example: We were swamped by an avalanche of letters/phone calls/complaints.
大批的來信／電話／投訴讓我們疲于應付。

NONE: › an extremely strong wish to get or keep money or possessions

example: Her business empire brought her wealth beyond the dreams of avarice (= an extremely large amount of money).
她的商業帝國帶給她的財富之巨是做夢都不敢想像的。
Synonym
greed

C: › an image that represents you in online games, chat rooms, etc. and that you can move around the screen
（網路遊戲或網路聊天室中的）虛擬化身
› especially in Hinduism, a god who appears on earth as a person
（印度神話中）下凡化作人形的神，化身

example: You can talk to other avatars with your words displayed in a cartoon bubble.
你可以和其他玩家的虛擬化身交談，你所鍵入的話語會出現在你虛擬化身頭上的一個卡通對話方塊中。
